property_summary: With _tos = [address(0x1), address(0x2)] and v = [100, 200], the REFERENCE iterates i < _tos.length (2 calls) and does not revert; the BUGGY version iterates i <= _tos.length (3 calls) causing an out-of-bounds array access on _tos[2] which reverts the call. The assertion checks that the function returns true.
